findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Define concurrency/ownership for the temporary branch and live ticket: either make the branch/ticket name per-run unique (e.g. include a run id) or state that only one E2E run may execute at a time (a lock), so overlapping runs cannot corrupt each other's create/cleanup.
evidence: 'create/update the temporary feature branch for the run ... clean it up after the run by deleting the temporary feature/e2e-gate-smoke branch/ref'
Fixed branch name with no per-run uniqueness or lock; live disposable ticket shared across runs.
No statement of update-concurrency/ownership for concurrent runs.
findings.finding: The temporary feature branch uses a fixed name (feature/e2e-gate-smoke) and a shared live disposable ticket, but the plan does not define ownership/concurrency for two overlapping runs. Two concurrent E2E invocations would create/observe/delete the same branch and touch the same live store, so one run's cleanup (branch delete) can undercut another run mid-flight, causing spurious harness failures or leaked refs.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a per-run unique branch suffix (e.g. feature/e2e-gate-smoke-<runid>) and a per-run disposable ticket, or acquire an exclusive run lock, so cleanup of one run never deletes another run's ref.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] State an explicit bounded timeout for the dual-vote wait loop and require a specific harness error naming the missing gate (LLM-Review or Verified) when the bound is exceeded.
evidence: The re-dispatch bounds only branch prerequisites: 'If the feature branch cannot be created, observed on the mirror, or deleted during cleanup, the E2E must fail with an explicit harness error ... rather than waiting forever for Verified.'

No bound is stated for the poll loop after the branch is observed but CI dispatch fails to cast Verified (e.g. platform CI never runs) — the loop could hang or the existing generic timeout may not name the Verified gate.
findings.finding: The vote-wait loop that now requires both LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 has no stated timeout/bound for the case where Verified never arrives after the feature branch is successfully observed on the mirror.
scenarios: Branch replicates to GitHub but the platform CI dispatch fails or is slow to cast Verified; the E2E hangs or times out with an unhelpful message.
findings.suggested_fix: Reuse/extend the existing wait-loop timeout so that when the bound is hit the script exits nonzero with a message identifying which required label (LLM-Review or Verified) was still missing on the tested patchset.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] State the vote-wait arm's disposition: bound the poll for LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1 with a deadline and fail explicitly (naming the missing gate) on timeout rather than waiting indefinitely.
evidence: 'require Verified.recommended (or equivalent +1) in addition to LLM-Review +1 before leaving the wait loop'
Branch-arm failure disposition is explicit ('fail with an explicit harness error ... rather than waiting forever'), but the vote-wait-timeout arm has no stated disposition word.
findings.finding: The plan states branch-replication/observe/cleanup failures surface as an explicit harness error rather than waiting forever, but it does not state the disposition when the vote wait loop times out without both LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 arriving (e.g. CI never dispatches Verified). It is unclear whether that surfaces as a bounded, explicit failure or an unbounded wait.
findings.location: Plan-review remediation 2026-09-06 (Gerrit polling / wait loop) and re-dispatch 2026-09-07
